description: 30 structured triage scenarios across dermatology, general medicine, and minor injury. Ground-truth urgency tiers follow standard triage reference guidelines (Dunn et al., The Emergency Medicine Manual).

scenarios.symptom: I have a red, itchy, circular patch on my forearm with a raised scaly border that has been slowly getting bigger over a week.
I got a mild sunburn on my shoulders yesterday, it is a bit red and warm but no blisters.
There are red streaks spreading up my arm from a cut, the area is hot and swollen and I now have a fever.
The skin between my toes is itchy, flaky and peeling, it has been like this for a few days.
A mole on my back has changed colour, grown, and now has irregular edges over the past two months.
I have a few pimples on my face that flared up this week, slightly red but not painful.
My face and lips are swelling rapidly with hives all over and my throat feels tight.
I have a small dry, itchy patch of eczema on my elbow like I sometimes get.
I have a painful band of blisters on just one side of my torso that appeared two days ago.
I have a widespread blistering rash with peeling skin, sores in my mouth, and a high fever.
I have a mild headache this evening after a long day at work, it eases when I rest.
I suddenly got the worst headache of my life with a stiff neck and sensitivity to light.
I have a runny nose, mild sore throat and sneezing since this morning, I feel a bit under the weather.
I have had a persistent dry cough for about three weeks that is not getting better.
I have crushing chest pain spreading to my left arm and jaw, I am sweating and short of breath.
My seasonal allergies are acting up with itchy eyes and sneezing, like every spring.
I have a fever of 39.5 C and I am becoming confused and very drowsy.
I get occasional heartburn after eating spicy food, an antacid usually settles it.
I have felt unusually tired for several weeks and have lost weight without trying.
I am suddenly struggling to breathe and feel short of breath even sitting still.
I got a tiny paper cut on my finger, it stung for a second and barely bled.
I rolled my ankle slightly, it is a little swollen but I can still walk on it without much pain.
I have a deep cut that is still bleeding heavily even after pressing on it for fifteen minutes.
I bumped my shin on a table and now have a small bruise, it is a bit tender.
I fell and now my wrist is severely painful, visibly bent at an odd angle and I cannot move it.
I touched a hot pan and have a small red mark on my finger, no blister, it just stings a little.
I jammed my finger playing cricket, it is swollen and painful but I can still bend it.
I hit my head in a fall, briefly blacked out, and have vomited twice since.
I have a small splinter in my fingertip, it is mildly annoying but not very painful.
I spilled boiling water and have a large blistering burn covering most of my forearm.
